g.text: Virtual try-on, idea to Play Store.
DOCKER · CADDY AUTO-HTTPS · GITHUB ACTIONS · HETZNER VPS
Image pipeline on OpenAI gpt-image, picked over Gemini
after testing face accuracy and cost.
Race-safe credits with row-level locking, Firebase Auth
and Razorpay webhooks for credit packs.
